decisions.reason: The existing message-785 MODIFY already updates all affected FAQ reward-delivery sections to the conditional winner-initiated claim flow.
The existing message-785 MODIFY already establishes the conditional claim button, its eligibility-based visibility, and removal of automatic prize delivery.
The source changes prize collection, while the $5 referral commission remains automatic, immediate, and payable to the referral-code holder.
Conditional prize claiming and the need to wait for the 100th sale do not change ticket award, counter, registration, or display rules.
The Mission page does not explicitly assert automatic prize transfer; its broad automated-payout wording can continue to describe automatic commissions and smart-contract execution.
The landing mechanics copy describes commissions, tickets, draw frequency, and winner selection but does not specify automatic versus claimed prize delivery.
The prize-claim decision does not change the hero's headline, CTA, layout, cover integration, or visual emphasis.
Winner-initiated prize claiming does not alter the existing Winners page, dashboard, or email announcement and notification requirements.
The collection method used after a winner is selected does not change Chainlink VRF selection, eligibility, weighting, or verifiability.
The conditional prize-claim flow does not change referral-code identity, lifetime, sharing methods, display surfaces, or resale behavior.
The source decision has no effect on the landing-page book cover's placement, size, crop, or visibility.
The NFT metadata state contains ticket, badge, referral-code, book-access, and reward-accounting attributes but no automatic prize-delivery attribute requiring revision.
